First, we speak to The Indian Express’ Siddharth Upasani about Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s criticism of India’s private sector, stagnant wages despite rising corporate profits, and what could encourage businesses to invest more.
Next, we speak to The Indian Express’ Mohamed Thaver about an alleged racket that enabled foreign-trained medical graduates to register as doctors in Maharashtra without clearing the mandatory screening examination. (14:05)
